summary: Yellow pixels inside colored-border regions move in the direction indicated by the red pixel in the legend with matching background color, stopping at region boundary.
src: yellow pixels inside colored-border regions s
path: move(s, direction=legend.red_pixel_offset) where legend.background_color == s.containing_region.border_color until s.touches(region_boundary)
symbol_instructions: legend on grid edge with background color C and red pixel indicates: yellow pixels in regions with border color C move in direction from blue center to red pixel
